rules.statement: An improving co-owner is entitled to compensation on the same principles as those applicable to a bona fide possessor, and the fruits of the improvement itself cannot be set off in calculating the amount of compensation.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover, this Court has laid down that an improving co-owner is entitled to compensation on the same principles as those applicable to a bona fide possessor, and it is well known that the fruits of the improvement itself cannot be set off in calculating the amount of compensation."
